title: Counter loop round orbit
statement: For a machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes, a function $\tau$ assigning a natural-number time bound to each configuration, an initial configuration $c$ on input $x$, and a natural number $r$, the counter loop orbit at $r$ is the round orbit of $M$ from $c$ under $\tau$ at round $r$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A symbol type, state set, and input list $x$
A function $\tau$ from configurations on $x$ to natural numbers
